say:2:1510745001:0.text: Nazrik! Herdmaster...! The Halians snuck into the forest!
say:2:1510745001:0.source_cn: 那……那非！狩猎神大人……！有人……有呼临人潜入了森林！
say:2:1510745001:0.male: Nazrik! Herdmaster...! The Halians snuck into the forest!
say:2:1510745001:0.female: Nazrik! Herdmaster...! The Halians snuck into the forest!

say:3:1510745002:1.text: How many? How long ago? Which way did they go?
say:3:1510745002:1.source_cn: 有几人？多久之前，朝哪个方向去了？

say:4:1510745003:1.text: There were only four or five at first. They were hiding in the brush, ambushed us when we weren't looking...!
say:4:1510745003:1.source_cn: 最开始只有四五个……他们藏在草丛里，趁我们不备才得手……！

say:5:1510745004:1.text: After they left, we heard the war horns from Veilwatch Camp. Then another group of Halians came through. I barely managed to drag my partner over here and hide...
say:5:1510745004:1.source_cn: 他们离开之后，逐影营地那边传来开战的号角声……后来又有...

say:6:1510745005:1.text: They were <style="highlight">moving toward the Primal Shrine</style>...
say:6:1510745005:1.source_cn: 他们都<style=highlight>朝着狩猎神殿的...

say:7:1510745006:1.text: ... So the Halians ambushed the guards on this path ahead of time. This was all planned.
say:7:1510745006:1.source_cn: ……看来呼临人提前伏击了这条路上的守卫。他们早有预谋。

say:8:1510745007:0.text: Nazrik... Is Veilwatch Camp alright? Did something happen?
say:8:1510745007:0.source_cn: 那非……逐影营地还好吗，是不是出了什么事？

say:9:1510745008:0.text: The Halians' attack failed. The second group you saw was them retreating. We're in pursuit.
say:9:1510745008:0.source_cn: 呼临人的进攻失败了。你第二次看到的那些人就是在逃跑，我...

say:12:1510745009:0.text: Your wounds aren't serious. I've stopped the bleeding. Get back to camp and recover.
say:12:1510745009:0.source_cn: 你的伤势不重。我为你止住了血，快回营地养伤吧。
